title: Part of Bohol national highway closed after Baclayon road sinks

blocks.text: BACLAYON, Bohol — A portion of the national highway in Barangay Taguihon here was closed on Wednesday after a section of the concrete road was found damaged and sinking, possibly due to a sinkhole. The local government said authorities are inspecting the affected portion to determine whether a sinkhole is causing its gradual collapse. As a safety precaution, authorities barred vehicles from passing through the affected section to prevent possible accidents. READ: Sinkhole discovered in Negros Occidental town Taguihon is one of Baclayon’s barangays along the national highway linking the town to Tagbilaran City and other municipalities in eastern Bohol.
